concerns.text: Task T010 contracts a test `tests/unit/test_loader.py::test_loader_raises_on_missing_wcs` (FR‑009) but there is no producer task that implements the FITS loader or its WCS validation logic. A task to develop `code/io/loader.py` (or equivalent) must be added before the contract test.

Task T028 calls `apply_correction()` which is only defined later in task T029b. The producer (implementation of `apply_correction`) must precede any consumer that invokes it; reorder T029b before T028 or adjust dependencies.

Task T038 adds a validation guard in `code/synthetic/artifacts.py` for saturation logic, but it is placed after the saturation generation task T021 and downstream sweep tasks (T024, T023). The guard must be implemented before any saturation images are created to be effective; move T038 earlier (e.g., before T021) or declare an explicit dependency.

Task T046a creates a CLI stub `code/main.py` and is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe), yet later tasks T046b, T046c, T015a, T015b, etc., modify the same `code/main.py`. This introduces a hidden ordering requirement, making the `[P]` tag unsafe. Change T046a to `[S]` or ensure it runs before any other task that edits `code/main.py`.
